It sounds like you're feeling disappointed about today, even though you did some good things like going to work on time and participating in training.  Could any of these thoughts be influencing how you feel:

It takes courage to step into new situations, and it's great that you were able to identify some of those anxious feelings. Your balanced thought shows real self-compassion - reminding yourself that learning and growth take time. You successfully managed your anxiety by focusing on the positives and keeping things in perspective, which led to a decrease in intensity. Keep up this good work!
